source: the existing warehouse source identity and stock store through WarehouseInventoryFixtureSource

transitions.plan: no source effect; one scoped transfer identity and original canonical resource digest
transitions.reserve: reduce origin available, increase origin reserved, retain on_hand; destination unchanged
transitions.dispatch: reduce origin reserved and on_hand, increase in_transit
transitions.receive: reduce in_transit and add the same quantity to destination available/on_hand
transitions.lose: reduce in_transit, preserve a source-linked lost-quantity record; do not add destination stock
transitions.correct_loss: reduce the named original loss and add only its corrected quantity at the destination
transitions.release: return only reserved, undispatched units to origin available

conservation: on_hand = available + reserved at each location
a unit cannot be available at origin and destination simultaneously

authority.proposal: current action.propose and resource access, anchored source-reconciled balances, current transfer revision and canonical resource digest
authority.approval: current owner/reviewer with action.approve on the resource, different from the proposer, exact command digest, bounded expiry
authority.final_boundary: repeat rechecks in the actual source-call callback after durable unknown persistence; the used approval is valid only for that original send

unknown.repair: lookup original operation_id at original source identity and import the existing movement receipts
unknown.absent_or_timeout_lookup: remain unknown; no replacement ID or automatically recreated command
unknown.other_transition: blocked while the transfer has a proposed or unknown operation
unknown.restore_quarantine: lookup can read; receipt import waits for write-enabled recovery state

storage.minimization: retain stable transfer/effect identity and stock audit; block reuse after erasure, never replay an uncertain effect from minimized data
storage.rollback: preserve pending/unknown operations and the native warehouse journal; restoration cannot turn an old transfer into new authority

tests.targeted_fault: actual isolated source mutates destination available at reservation while leaving origin available unchanged; literal native-stock oracle rejects it
tests.author_execution: none; integration owns the bounded native invocation and independent reviews

remaining_limits: no connected warehouse or real physical observations
stale proposed commands stay blocked and have no automatic reauthorization
a loss correction targets one prior loss receipt at a time
formal prerequisites and milestone acceptance remain blocked
